What's your return and refund policy?
Here’s a quick rundown of how returns and refunds work with us:
Returning rentals:
Items must be sent back on the last day of your rental using next‑day tracked delivery and arrive in the same condition you received them (no new damage, stains, or alterations).
You’re responsible for safe return and we strongly recommend insuring the parcel for the item’s full retail value.
Condition on return:
Items must be free from new damage or permanent stains, unaltered, and returned on time.
Normal wear and standard post‑rental cleaning is on the lender; extra cleaning, stain removal, or repairs can be charged back to you if the item comes back in worse condition.
If your rental arrives late:
If the item doesn’t arrive by the first day of your rental, you should contact the lender right away.
You’re generally entitled to a full refund if you return the item within 24 hours of delivery.
If you return it after 24 hours, a partial refund may be given depending on how many rental days were lost.
If you keep the item beyond the original rental period (even if it arrived late), you can lose refund eligibility and may incur late fees.
If your rental arrives damaged / in poor condition / not as described:
Take clear photos the same day it arrives and message the lender immediately.
If it can’t be used, return it within 24 hours and submit a refund request in the app.
General refund rules & process:
Refunds are usually requested from the Rental page in the app.
To qualify in most cases, the item must be returned within 24 hours of receiving it when there’s an issue (late arrival, poor condition, misrepresentation, or certain fit disputes).
Platform service fees are non‑refundable – refunds only apply to the rental cost.
Once approved, refunds typically process within about 8 working days.
Fit‑related refunds:
Each lender sets their own fit refund policy. Many state this in their bio.
For fit issues, any refunds are given as By Rotation app credit only, with no expiry, and cannot be converted to cash or your original payment method.
By Rotation does not issue a fit refund if the lender has clearly said they don’t offer refunds for fit.
If an item was misrepresented in fit or style:
You can raise a refund request in the app, and you should have proof you checked sizing/measurements beforehand.
When you’re not eligible for a refund:
If you keep and wear a late item instead of returning it within 24 hours.
If you keep the item for the full rental period, you generally won’t be eligible for a refund.
If you return your rental late, you may instead face late fees.
If you need more detail on a specific situation (late, damaged, or wrong size), tell me what’s going on and I can point you to the exact step you should take next, based only on our policy above.

What's your warranty policy on defective items?

Sent · Just now

ByRo Bot · AI

ByRo Bot · AI says:

We don’t describe it as a traditional warranty, but we do have clear protections if an item arrives defective or in poor condition.

If your rental arrives damaged or not as described, you should:
Take clear, same-day photos/video and message the lender immediately.
If it’s unusable, return it within 24 hours and request a refund from the lender.
If the lender doesn’t respond to your refund request within 72 hours, you can email help@byrotation.com with your rental details and evidence so we can step in.
Lenders are required to send items exactly as described and flag any existing wear before dispatch; renters must report poor condition items immediately to stay eligible for a refund.
Where damage or condition issues turn into a dispute, we review evidence (photos, videos, messages, receipts) and can arrange repair reimbursement or market-value reimbursement depending on the situation.

So, instead of a standard product warranty, we use a documented disputes and refund process to sort out defective or misrepresented rentals.
